title: Rental Tenure Share of the Deductible on First Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Claim Decisions
content:
These questions are answered from the tenure rule for first decisions on Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan claims.

**What does the tenure share do?**
The deductible charged on the decision is multiplied by the decision's tenure share of the deductible.

**What are its values?**
The decision's tenure share of the deductible is 0.5 when the covered rental's move-in date is 60 or more whole months before the loss date and the rental's ledger shows no rent payment reversal in the 12 whole months before the handling date, 0.75 when the move-in date is at least 24 and fewer than 60 whole months before the loss date and the ledger shows no such reversal, and 1 otherwise.

**Which records decide it?**
The covered Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement: its move-in date, measured to the claim's loss date, and its tenant ledger, searched for rent payment reversals in the 12 whole months before the handling date.

**Two clocks — which date ends each?**
Tenure runs from move-in to the **loss date**; the reversal look-back is the 12 whole months before the **handling date**.

**Quick table**

| Move-in to loss date | Rent payment reversal in the look-back | Tenure share |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 60 whole months or more | none | 0.5 |
| 24 to 59 whole months | none | 0.75 |
| fewer than 24 whole months | none | 1 |
| any | one or more | 1 |

**A worked figure (hypothetical).** A deductible of 300.00 with a tenure share of 0.75 becomes 225.00.
